question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

You can’t stop the _________ (outflow) of current.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**outflow**' means a movement away from a place(बाहर निकलना)

 
 
• **Example**- I am trying to measure the **outflow **of water/sewage from that pipe.
 
 
 
• **Influx **means large numbers of people or things arriving suddenly(अन्तर्वाह)
 
 
• **Example**-The city has experienced an **influx **of visitors
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of "**outflow**" is "**influx**".

Therefore, the **correct answer** is '**Influx**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meaning and example sentences:

 
• **Deluge**(बाढ़): a sudden, very heavy fall of rain; a flood.

 
 
• **Example**- A **deluge **of rain put a stop to the match
 
 
 
• **Income**(आमदनी): the money you receive in exchange for your labor or products
 
 
• Example-He earns a good **income **as a consultant.
 
 
 
• **Torrent**(धारा): a strong fast flow of something, especially water
 
 
• **Example**-The storm turned the stream into a raging **torrent**
